description:
Reid RB500 eBike | 20" Moto-Style Electric Bike
Bold café racer-inspired styling meets powerful electric performance in the RB500, a distinctive eBike built for riders who want more from every journey.
The Reid RB500 combines classic motorcycle-inspired styling with modern electric performance, creating a distinctive alternative to a conventional eBike. Its 6061 alloy frame, minimalist lines and bold stance give it a standout look, while its practical features make it suited to urban journeys and everyday adventures.
An Ananda 500W rear hub motor delivers responsive electric assistance, with 750W peak power and 65Nm of torque to help riders tackle hills and enjoy a more effortless ride. The 48V 13Ah (624Wh) integrated battery offers an approximate range of up to 60 miles (97km), depending on terrain, rider weight and riding style. With pedal assist and throttle control, riders can tailor the level of assistance to suit their journey.
Designed for a comfortable and confident ride, the RB500 features an alloy dual-crown suspension fork, 20" mag-style alloy wheels and wide 20 x 4.0" all-road tyres. This combination provides stability and cushioning across a variety of urban surfaces, while the distinctive wheel design adds to its moto-inspired appearance.
A Shimano 7-speed drivetrain provides flexibility across different routes and riding conditions, with an L-TWOO trigger shifter for straightforward gear changes. Tektro hydraulic disc brakes with 180mm rotors deliver reliable stopping power and control, while motor cut-off levers add an extra practical feature.
The Ananda colour display features Bluetooth connectivity and app compatibility, keeping essential ride information close at hand. Integrated front and rear LED lights, including a front daytime running light, help improve visibility when riding in different conditions.
Combining distinctive café racer styling, powerful electric assistance and quality components, the Reid RB500 offers a different take on everyday electric riding. It's built for riders who value individuality, performance and practicality in equal measure.
The RB500 eBike is ideal for:

Riders who want something different, with distinctive café racer-inspired styling and a bold moto-inspired design

Powerful electric assistance, with a 500W Ananda rear hub motor, 750W peak power and 65Nm of torque

Longer journeys, with a 48V 624Wh battery offering an approximate range of up to 60 miles (97km)

Flexible electric riding, with pedal assist and throttle control

Comfort across varied surfaces, with a dual-crown suspension fork and wide 20 x 4.0" tyres

Versatile everyday riding, with a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain

Controlled stopping power, with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes and 180mm rotors

Connected ride information, with a colour display and Bluetooth app connectivity

Improved visibility, with integrated front and rear LED lights
